extDescription.message: Print or save as PDF your ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and other AI conversations in a clean view with highlighted code.

notFound.message: Conversation not found. Click the extension icon again on the chat tab.

printHint.message: In the print dialog choose "Save as PDF" as the destination.

welcomeLead.message: Save as PDF or print your conversations with any AI in a clean view, without menus or buttons. Here is how, in three steps:

step1Title.message: Pin the extension to the toolbar

step1Text.message: Click the puzzle piece icon at the top right of Chrome, then the pin next to “AI → PDF”. The icon will then always be visible.

step2Title.message: Open the chat and click the icon

step2Text.message: Load the conversation you want to save on the AI's website and click the extension icon. It goes through the whole chat, even long ones.

step3Text.message: A tab opens with the clean view. Adjust what you like (title, size, show or hide your messages) and click Print / Save PDF. As the destination choose “Save as PDF”.

tipSelection.message: If you select some text before clicking the icon, only that part is printed.

tipOther.message: On websites that aren't AI chats, it prints the main content of the page.

welcomePrivacy.message: The extension only reads the tab when you click the icon. Everything is processed in your browser and nothing is sent to any server.
